caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bucket made from vertical brown wooden planks, bound together by two greenish metallic bands, one near the base and another just above the center, with a wider reddish-brown wooden band positioned near the top. The bucket's wood has visible grain lines and shading that gives a sense of texture and dimension. Protruding from the top of the bucket is a flat wooden handle with a heart-shaped end, colored in a similar brown as the rest of the bucket. Around the central, colored illustration of the bucket are four smaller, unfinished line drawings/sketches of the same bucket from various views and angles, as well as two top-down views showing the circular shape of the bucket, positioned on the upper left side. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing does not contain any additional objects or elements.
title: Wooden Noggin
